title: Build the smallest multimodal route that can keep its promise
description: Select a task, admit only useful evidence, and choose where modalities meet. The estimates are illustrative comparison values; calibrate them with your own encoders, model, hardware, and request traces.

modalities.label: Text and metadata
modalities.detail: Instructions, structured fields, retrieved policy, and identifiers.

modalities.label: Image evidence
modalities.detail: Layout, objects, handwriting, charts, and spatial relationships.

modalities.label: Audio evidence
modalities.detail: Speech, timing, speakers, and non-verbal sound events.

modalities.label: Temporal frames
modalities.detail: Ordered video samples that preserve change and action over time.

fusionOptions.label: Joint token fusion
fusionOptions.detail: Encode modalities into one model context for fine-grained cross-modal reasoning.
fusionOptions.conflictVisibility: Joint reasoning is expressive, but source-level disagreements can become harder to inspect.

fusionOptions.label: Evidence-level fusion
fusionOptions.detail: Extract typed claims per modality, then compare provenance and confidence explicitly.
fusionOptions.conflictVisibility: Typed claims make disagreement inspectable, at the cost of some fine-grained interaction.

fusionOptions.label: Cheap-first cascade
fusionOptions.detail: Run a low-cost route first and invoke richer media processing only when the task requires it.
fusionOptions.conflictVisibility: A cascade saves work, but its gate can suppress evidence before the richer route sees it.

tasks.label: Validate an invoice before payment
tasks.brief: Read layout and amounts, compare purchase-order context, and hold contradictions.
tasks.consequence: A wrong amount can trigger an irreversible financial action, so extracted claims need provenance and deterministic validation.

tasks.label: Summarize a recorded meeting
tasks.brief: Combine the agenda with speech while keeping speakers, decisions, and uncertainty traceable.
tasks.consequence: The summary can be asynchronous, but decisions and owners must trace back to timestamps rather than fluent reconstruction.

tasks.label: Review a safety inspection video
tasks.brief: Preserve scene detail and event order before proposing a safety finding.
tasks.consequence: A sampled frame can miss the event that proves or disproves a hazard, so temporal coverage is part of the safety contract.
